key.name: setups
key.description: JSON array of saved setups (display layout, audio output and commands).

key.name: login-setup
key.description: Empty: do not change anything. "__last__": the last used setup. Otherwise the id of a saved setup.

key.name: last-setup
key.description: Id of the last setup that was applied or detected as active.

key.name: run-commands-at-login
key.summary: Run the setup's commands when it is applied at login

key.name: confirm-changes
key.description: Show GNOME's "Keep these display settings?" dialog after switching. Changes revert automatically if not confirmed.

key.name: hide-unavailable
key.summary: Hide setups whose screens are not connected
